```yaml
name: Consolidate Agentic Workflow Discussions
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - 'docs/audit-workflows.md'
      - 'docs/portfolio-analyst.md'
      - '**/lock.json'
      - '**/package-lock.json'
      - '**/yarn.lock'

jobs:
  consolidate-discussions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Update audit-workflows.md category
        run: |
          sed -i 's/category: "q-a"/category: "agentic-workflows"/' docs/audit-workflows.md

      - name: Update portfolio-analyst.md category
        run: |
          sed -i 's/category: Audits/category: "agentic-workflows"/' docs/portfolio-analyst.md

      - name: Recompile lock files
        run: |
          # For npm projects
          if [ -f "package-lock.json" ]; then
            npm install --package-lock-only
          fi
          
          # For yarn projects
          if [ -f "yarn.lock" ]; then
            yarn install --mode=update-lockfile
          fi
          
          # For go projects
          if [ -f "go.mod" ]; then
            go mod tidy
          fi

      - name: Commit changes
        uses: stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action@v5
        with:
          commit_message: "chore: consolidate agentic workflow discussions to single category"
          commit_options: "--signoff"
          branch: main
          file_pattern: |
            docs/audit-workflows.md
            docs/portfolio-analyst.md
            **/lock.json
            **/package-lock.json
            **/yarn.lock
            go.mod
            go.sum

      - name: Create discussion in Agentic Workflows category
        uses: peter-evans/create-issue-from-file@v5
        with:
          issue-number: 1
          title: "Agentic Workflow Discussion Consolidation Complete"
          content: |
            All agentic workflow discussions have been consolidated to the "agentic-workflows" category.
            
            Changes made:
            - audit-workflows.md: Updated category from "q-a" to "agentic-workflows"
            - portfolio-analyst.md: Updated category from "Audits" to "agentic-workflows"
            - Lock files recompiled to reflect updated configuration
            
            This ensures all agentic workflows that write discussions now write to the Agentic Workflows group.
          labels: maintenance, documentation
          assignees: copilot
```
